messages:
jordan: FYI opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — airgapped CLI quickstart updates for Private/VPC KMS + HSM. Mostly UX fixes, a new troubleshooting section, and examples for systemd + PKCS#11. Can @lex @mira give infra/network review?

lex: Quick skim — overall great. Two quick nits: 1) the current `curl` healthcheck will fail in many airgapped installs (no DNS/curl TLS roots). Suggest adding an `openssl s_client` example and a note about supplying CA bundle. 2) firewall table is missing UDP/53 DNS for some semiairgap setups. I'll add inline comments.

sam: I can take the HSM PKCS#11 snippet and test on our lab HSM. Also we should include a short systemd drop-in example showing LimitNOFILE and the env for the proxy.

mira: Please add a short note about MTU issues. We've hit packet fragmentation on Azure with jumbo frames when tenant does overlay networking. Add a troubleshooting bullet and reference to the port matrix doc.

jordan: Added a troubleshooting heading and included MTU note. For the TLS check, added this openssl example:
```
openssl s_client -connect 10.0.0.5:443 -servername kms.internal.local -CAfile /etc/redwood/ca.pem
```
Also added a minimal iptables accept snippet and clarifying text about using `--insecure` is not recommended. Please review.

lex: Small consistency question: do we call the KMS port 443 or 7443 in Quickstart? I see both in older pages. Let's standardize to 7443 for Private installs and mention 443 for hosted-compatible setups. Leaving inline comment.

mira: For the PKCS#11 example, show the module path and set ulimit/rlimit. Example: `export PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so` and `ulimit -n 65536` before starting agent.

sam: Adding the systemd unit drop-in I promised:
```
[Service]
Environment=KMS_PROXY_URL=https://127.0.0.1:8443
LimitNOFILE=65536
ExecStart=/usr/bin/redwood-agent --config /etc/redwood/agent.yaml
```
This reflects what the agent expects in the private installer.

jordan: Thanks — incorporated the systemd snippet and the PKCS#11 env example. Also CI flagged a broken link to `/docs/private/kms/legacy`; I've swapped it for `/docs/private/kms/overview` and updated the anchor names.

docs-bot: link-checker: replaced 1 broken link in PR #482; remaining checks: linter warnings on wrapping and a small markdown lint about headings.

release-manager: :thumbsup: Can we get this landed before Friday's release? If yes, tag with `release-candidate` and I'll queue it for cherry-pick into the release branch.

lex: I will confirm the port standardization and update the port-matrix doc reference. If that looks good, I can merge and add the label — should be ~2 hours. :shipit:

mira: I'll post a short note in #release-war-room after merge so oncall knows about the MTU troubleshooting addition.

jordan: Added a short release notes blurb and changelog entry in the PR. Thanks everyone, will follow up if CI still complains.

(attachments: none)
